reviews.text:
UPDATE: Still waiting for the Favorites to work! Fix this already!!  Now most watch faces take 2-3 tries to download and some never do! Ridiculous for $40! 

I was very excited to see the huge selection of watch faces, downloaded a couple to my watch, and then bought the ten buck first year subscription. Then I discovered that about 1 in 3 of the faces with more complications just won’t work no matter what you do. I’ve tried opening Facer on my watch to refresh complications but that rarely works. So then I’ve rebooted both my watch and my iPhone as they suggested but that doesn’t work either very often. It doesn’t seem to happen with any particular creator either, so it seems to be a problem with Facer not the designers. The faces with just rotating photos download fine, just not some of the ones with health or weather complications. 

     Also Favorites hearts are no longer showing up, so you can’t edit your Favorites. The faces still save to Favorites but you end up with tons of them because the hearts no longer show up to “unheart” any of them. And every time
you go into a face on your list and go back out, it goes back to the top of your list. There seems to be no way to organize Favorites either. In short, this app just needs work!

reviews.title: Well, glad I didn’t pay
reviews.text:
So, this is my first time having an Apple Watch, and after reading reviews about the best apps, Facer was always brought up, so I figured I’d try it. I should have read the reviews.
While, yes, they have nice watch faces, this isn’t what I was expecting. Upon trying like 10-11 faces, all different styles, I found that yes, easy to apply to the watch, but none of the watch widgets actually work when pressing them on the watch. All that happens when pressed is your watch says something along the lines of… trying to initiate with Facer app, not to said widget. 
So, with all that said, be weary of what you can actually do with watch apps. They advertise that each app is the best, but 99% barely even work, and some will only stay on the watch face for an hour maybe a couple days. Good Luck, Watch Universe
